# Arizona Product Destruction (APD)

> A direct product destruction company in Phoenix, Arizona. APD is not a broker — it destroys recalled, expired, damaged, faulty, discontinued and unsellable product in its own two Phoenix warehouses, and documents every load with a Certificate of Destruction.

## Key facts

- **Location:** Phoenix, Arizona, USA. Two warehouses.
- **Phone:** (928) 554-5137
- **Email:** info@azproductdestruction.com
- **Founded:** Purchased by Beth Williamson in 2021 out of Recycle One (Arizona Pacific Paper); over 23 years of combined operating history in product destruction.
- **Ownership:** SBA-certified Woman-Owned Small Business.
- **Certification:** The only Coca-Cola certified product destruction company in Arizona.
- **Scale:** 40+ employees; processes roughly 80% of Arizona's beverage market and about 724,000 gallons of beverage per year.
- **Sustainability (2025 figures):** 26,000 tons of old corrugated cardboard recycled; over 800 tons of metals diverted; more than 180 loads routed to approved waste-to-energy facilities. Across all materials received, more than 72% has a downstream second use, and zero beverage product enters the public sewer.
- **Service area:** Based in Arizona, serving customers across the continental U.S. Within Arizona — from Page to Tucson, and Yuma to Flagstaff — logistics are handled with APD's own dedicated local fleet. Beyond Arizona, trusted shipping partners service the entire lower 48. For specialty product destruction, APD has partnered with destruction facilities across the Southwest.

## What makes APD different

Most product destruction companies are brokers: they take a job and hand it to a third-party facility, adding markup and removing visibility. APD owns its equipment and warehouses, so product never changes hands. That means direct pricing with no middleman margin, a single point of contact who can answer for the work itself, and the option to watch your own product be destroyed live on APD's floor.

## Proof of destruction

Every load closes with a Certificate of Destruction recording product type and quantity, date and method of destruction, disposition, and batch or lot numbers where traceability is required. Three proof formats are available: video of the destruction, photographic documentation, or live on-site viewing at the Phoenix warehouse.

## Services

- [Beverages](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/beverages): Cans, bottles and kegs destroyed on proprietary equipment with a zero-product-to-sewer commitment.
- [Psyllium](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/psyllium): Fiber supplements and powdered product destroyed on purpose-built machinery, then repurposed into a new secondary use.
- [OCC / Cardboard](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/occ-cardboard): Corrugated cardboard, shrink wrap and film sorted, baled and routed to recyclers.
- [Liquidation Pallets](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/liquidation-pallets): Retail returns, overstock and damaged goods destroyed so they cannot re-enter resale.
- [Textiles & Apparel](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/textiles-apparel): Branded garments shredded past resale value, with labels, tags and trim handled separately.
- [Footwear & Accessories](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/footwear-accessories): Soles, uppers and hardware separated so product cannot be rebuilt or resold.
- [Electronic Waste](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/electronic-waste): Data-bearing components handled separately from general e-waste; metals recovered.
- [Aluminum & Metals](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/aluminum-metals): Metals separated on-site during destruction and diverted to recyclers.
- [General Consumer Goods](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/general-consumer-goods): Health and beauty, home goods and mixed-category overstock.
- [Packaging Materials](https://azproductdestruction.com/services/packaging-materials): Film, shrink wrap, corrugated and rigid plastics recovered rather than trashed.
